'''2000 DecipherCon 8-Man (Saturday, Charles Hickey)''' was a Star Wars CCG side event held in Kissimmee, Florida on 7 October 2000. [[Charles Hickey]] won it. It is known from Charles Hickey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1343">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-14-mr-hickey-goes-to-floridad1343/ mr-hickey-goes-to-florida], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 14 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-14-mr-hickey-goes-to-floridad1343/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[DecipherCon 2000]].

* '''Date:''' 7 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Kissimmee, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Charles Hickey]]
